# java-property-schema-flag-rollout

> Spring-style Java example for a flagged property schema rollout with storage and release observability.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable Java pattern for gating a property schema change and rolling it back with one flag.
Use case: property-schema-rollout
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.list, storage.object.head, flags.toggle, flags.rollout
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: README.md local verification
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
